Select any number of files from your computer. Attach tags to each image and send them as formData in the API request. The images will display in your Asset Library (see below).


You must request to have the asset library enabled. Please contact your CSM for assistance.
Note: This endpoint only accepts .jpg, .jpeg, or .png files.

Python
